# Nirmanam Solutions

> Nirmanam Solutions is a premier software engineering and product design studio headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India, serving global tech clients, Indian startups, and enterprise organizations worldwide.

## Core Capabilities
- Web Platforms: Server-rendered React/Next.js architectures, WebGL interactions, sub-second initial load speeds, and scalable frontends.
- Mobile Application Engineering: Cross-platform iOS & Android mobile systems using React Native & Flutter, 60fps gesture rendering, offline-first sync, and hardware integrations.
- Custom Systems & APIs: Resilient distributed Node.js/PostgreSQL/GraphQL backends, microservices, and event-driven architecture.
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, Kubernetes, and AWS deployment.
- UI/UX Design Systems: High-fidelity Figma component systems, interactive micro-animations, and conversion rate design audits.

## Featured Portfolio Systems
- Sravase Dairy Management System: Full-stack dairy platform for farmers and collection centers with real-time milk logging, automated FAT/SNF pricing calculations, and mobile Android app.
- SkillSutra E-Learning Platform: Secure educational LMS with Stripe payment integration, HLS DRM video streaming protection, and progress tracking.
